title: Report wolfSSL 5.9.4 ECDH bug: valid x=0 shared secret rejected (ECC_INF_E)
description: wolfSSL 5.9.4's SP-math identity check in wc_ecc_shared_secret treats an all-zero x-coordinate as infinity. P-256/384/521 have valid points with x=0, and Wycheproof tcId 3 on each curve ('x**2 = 0') expects success. The source is the OR-accumulate check added with PRs 11173/11172/11233. File it upstream. wolfcrypt-conformance tests/wycheproof_ecdh.rs tolerates exactly this case and asserts it happens once per curve; remove that block when wolfSSL is fixed (the test fails once it is).
